SELECT sku.sku, -- 품목코드 sku.sku_name, -- 품목명 sku.spec, -- 규격 sku.unit, -- 단위 unit.unit_price_type, -- 단가유형 cmCode.code_name, -- 단가유형이름 unit.unit_price -- 단가 FROM tb_sku_master sku JOIN tb_unit_price_master unit ON sku.sku = unit.sku JOIN tb_cm_code cmCode ON unit.unit_price_type = cmCode.code WHERE sku.sku_type = 'ITEM' AND unit.unit_price_type = 'SELL_UNIT'

SELECT FN_MAKE_DATE_CODE('INORD') FROM DUAL
?INSERT InTO tb_inord (company_code, inord_no, inord_date, due_date, dept, pic, cust_code, cust_name, total_supply_price, total_surtax, total_price, created_by, create_date) VALUES ('0000', #{inordNo}, #{inordDate}, #{dueDate}, #{dept}, #{pic}, #{custCode}, #{custName}, #{totalSupplyPrice}, #{totalSurtax}, #{totalPrice}, '박봉근', SYSDATE)

SELECT FN_MAKE_DATE_CODE('INORD_DETAIL') FROM DUAL
?INSERT INTO tb_inord_detail (inord_detail_no, company_code, inord_no, sku, qty, unit_price, supply_price, surtax, price, remark, created_by, create_date) VALUES ( #{inordDetailNo}, '0000', #{inordNo}, #{sku}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice}, #{supplyPrice}, #{surtax}, #{price}, #{remark}, '박봉근', SYSDATE)
mapper.select:
SELECT ior.company_code , ior.inord_no , ior.inord_date , ior.cust_code , ior.cust_name , iod.inord_detail_no , iod.sku , sku.sku_name , iod.qty , iod.unit_price , nvl(iod.supply_price, 0) supply_price , nvl(iod.surtax, 0) surtax , nvl(iod.price, 0) price FROM tb_inord ior JOIN tb_inord_detail iod ON ior.company_code = iod.company_code AND ior.inord_no = iod.inord_no JOIN tb_sku_master sku ON iod.company_code = sku.company_code AND iod.sku = sku.sku WHERE 1=1
AND ior.cust_code LIKE '%' || #{custCode} || '%'
AND ior.cust_name LIKE '%' || #{custName} || '%'
AND iod.sku like '%' || #{sku} || '%'
AND sku.sku_name like '%'|| #{skuName} ||'%'
AND iod.invoice_status = '0'
AND iod.output_status != '0'
AND ior.inord_date = ior.inord_date AND ior.inord_no = ior.inord_no
